summary: Ansible-initiated Terraform patterns: prepare what Terraform cannot (state backend, initial cloud credentials) then run terraform apply; turn off Ansible monitoring while Terraform modifies infrastructure then re-enable it; or trigger terraform apply from events like ServiceNow tickets through an AAP webhook.
questions: What workflows can AAP run with Terraform?
How do I trigger terraform apply from a ServiceNow ticket?
Should I pause Ansible monitoring while running terraform apply?
